Initial release of pet eating speed slow feed analysis skill.

- Enables analysis of pet eating speed using food-bowl area videos via server-side API, supporting local files and URLs.
- Detects feeding start/end times, calculates speed (g/s and sec/bowl), and identifies risks if speed is below safety threshold (e.g., <30 sec/bowl).
- Automatically emits intervention suggestions (e.g., slow-feed baffle or voice alert) to help prevent choking and vomiting; does not diagnose diseases.
- Provides clear workflow for open-id acquisition, video requirements, and strict usage rules for analysis and historical report queries.
- Outputs analysis and history in standardized formats, including Markdown tables with direct report links for easy review.
